evidence.reason: The after version removes the metering.initialize() call that existed before, eliminating a side effect that may be required before metering.evaluate is used.
The after version adds a flat +3 to the returned value, changing the numeric contract for any caller that depends on the previous formula.
The after version swaps priorities to [multiplier/2, multiplier], so priorities[0] changes from multiplier to multiplier/2, altering the computed charge for every caller.
The relationship notes that chargeUnit is value-referenced by subscriptionCharge and by usageCharge, so changes in either symbol can affect the shared chargeUnit-based computation.
The test only asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, which is too weak to detect the removal of metering.initialize() or the +3 offset.
The test only asserts usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0, which does not pin down the priority ordering changed in usageCharge.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动分别删除了初始化副作用并改变了计费系数，现有测试过弱，无法确认合并后行为仍满足调用方依赖的契约。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 的作者恢复 metering.initialize() 调用并说明 +3 偏移的意图，同时请 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的作者确认 priorities 顺序调整是否与调用方预期一致，并补充能覆盖这两种行为的测试。
